subject.title: fix(agents): handle explicit empty tool lists in system prompt

question: Should this PR keep the new fail-closed OpenResponses hosted-tool name and duplicate-name validation, or narrow the branch to the explicit no-tool prompt/report bug?
rationale: That validation changes a public OpenResponses request path and could reject existing clients, which is a compatibility choice rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Preserve existing OpenResponses hosted-tool acceptance unless a separate maintainer-approved contract change is added with focused compatibility tests.

options.title: Accept stricter validation
options.body: Keep the fail-closed validation and document that unusual hosted tool names, normalized aliases, and duplicate names now return invalid_request_error.

options.title: Split or pause the branch
options.body: Ask for a smaller current-main PR for the prompt/report fix and handle hosted-tool validation separately.

recommendation.title: Narrow before merge
recommendation.body: Preserve existing OpenResponses hosted-tool acceptance unless a separate maintainer-approved contract change is added with focused compatibility tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The relevant prompt/report and OpenResponses current-main lines are in recent history attributed to steipete, and this is the broadest owner signal in the inspected paths.
